title: The Hell I Won’t
author: Wade Skeen
description:
There's the hunt everybody sees; the sunrise, the pile pics, the grip’n grins, the curated social media. 

Everybody smiling like it played out perfectly.

And then there’s everything you DON’T see.

The Money. The Mistakes.The Long Days. The decisions: the good ones and the ones that seemed like a damn fine idea at the time.

And somewhere in the middle of all that, there's a man trying to run an outfitting business with his wife.

We talk hunting and conservation, the business behind it, the people that make it worth it, and the ones that make you question your life’s choices.

We sure as hell don’t claim to be perfect or pretend we get it right every time. Our answers might not be politically correct or what you'd expect. We'll probably step on a few toes but no topic’s off limits, no stories left untold.

And when somebody says “you probably shouldn’t talk about that…”

THE HELL I WON’T.

title: Humble Followers of Christ
author: Humble Followers of Christ
description:
Hi there!  Welcome to ”The Humble Followers of Christ” podcast!  I’m just an average member of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints following promptings from the Lord to share insights and spiritual lessons I’ve received.  
This podcast is for those striving to be the ”humble followers of Christ” spoken of in 2 Nephi 28: 14, ”They wear stiff necks and high heads; yea, and because of pride, and wickedness, and abominations, and whoredoms, they have all gone astray save it be a few, who are the humble followers of Christ; nevertheless, they are led, that in many instances they do err because they are taught by the precepts of men.”
This podcast is NOT meant to find fault with the church or any of its teachings - rather it is meant to identify the precepts of men that often creep into our teachings due to our fallen nature, and seek what the Lord has said through his holy scriptures. 
Thank you for being here - I hope this podcast blesses you and helps you come nearer to the Lord Yeshua.  Pray about all that is shared, and He will help you sort out the truth of it all.  
Much love,
Anonymous

title: The Binge: What Happened to the Harrisons?
author: Sony Music Entertainment
description:
From the outside, 3635 Pitch Pine Crescent looked like the kind of home where nothing bad could happen, the gathering place for every birthday and holiday. Until, one spring night when tragedy struck. In less than five years, three people would end up dead in the same house. Each time, the authorities found a way to explain it away. But the family who loved them knew something was wrong.

Host Amy Dempsey Raven, an investigative reporter for the Toronto Star, spent more than a decade asking what really happened inside that house? Binge all episodes of What Happened to the Harrisons? now by subscribing to The Binge. Visit ⁠⁠⁠The Binge Crimes⁠⁠⁠ on Apple Podcasts and hit ‘subscribe’ or visit ⁠⁠⁠GetTheBinge.com⁠⁠⁠ to get access.

author: clqisp@samiahrafnirob.com
description:
The Reel tells the true stories behind the movies that shaped our world. Each episode, host Nirob takes one film, one filmmaker, or one moment in cinema — the first films, Charlie Chaplin, Citizen Kane, Casablanca, Hitchcock, Kurosawa, Star Wars — and rebuilds it: the film and the people who made it, the making, the screen, and the legacy it left.

From the magicians of early cinema to the golden age of Hollywood, from the silent era to the blockbuster, from animation to the largest film industry in the world, The Reel is about the art form that defined the twentieth century — how movies are made, why they move us, and how a strip of celluloid became the world's shared dream. Meticulously researched, honest about what is documented and what is legend. Clean and suitable for all ages. A new story every week

That is exactly why this podcast exists.
Beauty, Backed by Science is hosted by Amy Hupe, a Board Certified Nurse Practitioner and expert in aesthetic and wellness medicine, and the founder of The Downtown Wellness Spa. Each episode, Amy breaks down the science behind aesthetic treatments, regenerative therapies, and skin longevity in a way that actually makes sense, so you can stop guessing and start investing in what works.
Whether you are curious about Botox for the first time, exploring peptides and longevity therapies, or trying to cut through the noise on what skincare products actually do, this podcast is your no fluff guide to looking and feeling your best from the inside out.

description:
I was kidnapped to Saudi Arabia as a child.
Naturally, I turned the experience into a one-woman comedy show.
Then something unexpected happened. Other people who’d been kidnapped as children started finding me.
So this is where the conversation carries on.
I’m a writer, actor and trained counsellor, which means I’m professionally qualified to sit with difficult feelings and personally qualified to make inappropriate jokes about them.

No trauma porn. No inspirational music swelling underneath.

title: Word Stars

description: SHAKESPEARE WAS A WORD STAR - and so are you! After a snippet of Gregorian chant ('Veni Creator Spiritus' by Fideascende), host Lucy McIvor repeats a Shakespearean sonnet 3x, interspersed with the sound of a gong. Suitable for use as a word lullaby for babies... for adults and children in need of a bedtime ritual... for those looking to memorize or understand the sonnets... or for anyone requiring a gentle reset at any time of day. title: Carried Through: Evidence, Advocacy and the Fight for Every Patient
author: Dr. Valencia Hood-Humphrey
description:
What happens when someone finally fights for you?


That question sits at the heart of Carried Through, a podcast about evidence-based patient advocacy, health equity, and the tools every patient deserves but most never receive.


Dr. Valencia Hood-Humphrey, DrPH, MSc, BCPA, is a Doctor of Public Health, a scholar-practitioner in evidence-based practice and implementation science, and a Board Certified Patient Advocate. As Founder & CEO of Insightful Doc™ Consulting, LLC, she brings extensive experience across biopharmaceutical quality, regulatory, and medical affairs. She knows how the system builds treatments from the inside, and exactly where it loses sight of the person waiting for them.


Before she was a scientist, an industry professional, or a patient advocate, Dr. Valencia was a child who was misdiagnosed. What was dismissed as a stomach virus became a ruptured appendix, emergency surgery, and an uncertain prognosis. She remembers her father carrying her through the emergency room doors.

Carried Through: Evidence, Advocacy and the Fight for Every Patient is for patients, families, and communities who deserve both the evidence and someone in their corner.

Learn more at insightfuldoc.com. Follow on Instagram: @insightfuldocllc

Hosted by passionate cinephiles and narrative analysts, each episode dissects forgotten classics, psychological cinema, production folklore, and the haunting mechanics of visual storytelling.From lost silent-era masterworks and uncanny film anomalies to the cultural mythologies that shape how we view movies, The Reel and the Real strips away the glitter of Hollywood to examine what happens when light, shadow, and human obsession collide.Whether you are a seasoned film theorist, an aspiring director, or simply someone who loves atmospheric storytelling with a touch of dark intrigue, step into the projection booth with us.New episodes drop weekly. Turn down the lights, put on your headphones, and step beyond the frame.

title: Get Better @ Military Transitions
author: Justin and Noel
description: Transitioning from military service to civilian life can feel overwhelming—but you don’t have to navigate it alone. Join U.S. Army veteran Justin Miller and U.S. Marine Corps veteran Noel Wolf for honest conversations about finding purpose, building connections, and preparing for what comes next. Through shared experiences, practical insights, and helpful resources, they’re on a mission to help service members and veterans “Get Better at Transitioning” into civilian life.

title: The Rider and the Elephant
author: Cristina and Aaron
description: Why is knowing you need to change rarely enough to help you actually do it? Aaron and Cristina unpack the human experience of change through the Rider (our rational mind), the Elephant (our emotions and habits), and the Path (our environment). They examine what happens when these forces fall out of alignment. Discover practical reflection questions and tools to move beneath default reactions, reconnect with your agency, and shift from awareness into conscious action in life, teams, or organizations to activate change.

title: The Drawbridge Podcast - Episode 1
author: mowlaraymond
description: Today we delve into the world of AI and share some great insights for beginners to grow in awareness and avoid the pitfalls about the topic. Learn how you can begin applying AI technology in positive and beneficial ways to your lives. Check it out to hear more!

title: The Un-Wounding
author: Teresa / Alive Style Wellness
description: Welcome to The Unwounding. Wounding is what happened to us—the times we felt unseen as children, left out when we wanted to belong, or made to feel we had to earn love. But that little prefix, “un-,” opens the door to something different: an active, intentional unraveling of the knot. Not erasing our past or pretending it didn’t hurt, but gently loosening the meanings and beliefs we’ve carried because of it. Each week, this is our space to pause, look beneath the surface of what stirred our pain, and ask the question at the heart of this show: “What does this situation represent to my heart?”

title: Confident Her Podcast - Confidence, Mindset & Personal Growth
author: Quoiyaa
description: Welcome to Confident Her Podcast, your space for building confidence, improving self-worth, and personal growth. If you struggle with self-doubt, overthinking, comparison, or caring what people think, you’re in the right place. Learn how to overcome fear, strengthen your mindset, build self-esteem, practice self-love, and start pursuing your goals with confidence. It’s time to stop holding yourself back and become the woman you know you’re meant to be. 💕

title: First Steps English for Beginners
author: YOUR ENGLISH TOOLBOX
description:
This podcast is created through a human-led editorial process. Every episode concept, educational strategy, narrative direction and final editorial decision is developed and reviewed by people committed to making English learning meaningful. Artificial intelligence supports script development and editing, while ElevenLabs provides the synthetic voices of our hosts. Human judgement leads the process; technology supports its production.


A small story you can follow. Real English you can use. Follow Maya, Leo and their neighbours through connected stories of new beginnings, family and courage. Hear each conversation at natural speed, explore it slowly with Peter, learn useful everyday sentences, practise them, then listen again. Designed for adults taking their first confident steps in English.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

author: Rachel Koko
description:
Journeys is a storytelling podcast by Radiant Grace Productions that shares the stories of people, places, organizations, and experiences that might otherwise go untold. Every person has a story shaped by where they’ve been. what they’ve experienced, and who they are becoming. Through Journeys, I get to know the people behind the stories and explore the journeys that have led them to where they are now. Learn more about each series: 
Reflections: Personal stories and thoughtful reflections on faith, disability, family, uncertainty, grief, healing, and hope.
Becoming: Meaningful conversations with host Rachel Koko about identity, faith, resilience, healing, and the unexpected journeys that shape who we are becoming.
Discoveries:  Stories that uncover the meaning held within people, places, organizations, culture, traditions, history, and the experiences that connect us.
Carrying the Flag: (COMING SOON) Discovering the people and legacies shaping Olympic and Paralympic sport. Telling the stories of athletes, families, coaches, and communities _ and what it means to represent their home country and carry the flag on the world stage.

title: The Jackson Interaction Podcast
author: Jackson Media Creations
description:
Real People. Real Stories. Great Conversations.

Everybody has a story. Gene Jackson wants to hear it!

Welcome to The Jackson Interaction Podcast, where host Gene Jackson sits down with professional wrestlers, stand-up comedians, authors, and other fascinating personalities for conversations that go beyond the usual interview questions.

From the wrestling ring to the comedy stage to the pages of your favorite books, Gene talks with the people who entertain us, inspire us, and sometimes leave us scratching our heads. What makes them tick? How did they get where they are? What happens when things don't go according to plan? And what are the stories they don't usually get the chance to tell? 

Whether it's discussing life on the road with a professional wrestler, the unpredictable world of stand-up comedy, or the creative process behind writing a book, The Jackson Interaction is all about getting to know the person behind the profession.

Expect honest conversations, plenty of laughs, unexpected stories, and the occasional trip off the beaten path (sometimes those are the best parts). No cookie cutter interviews. No boring conversations. Just Gene Jackson interacting with interesting people from all walks of entertainment.

Watch or listen on YouTube, Rumble, Patreon, Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and Substack.

A Jackson Media Creations Production.

Welcome to The Soul Edit, a weekly space to nourish your spirit and edit the noise of a crowded world. Hosted interchangeably by a husband-and-wife duo, we bring two perspectives to the foundations of faith.
Whether you’re a beginner or seeking a quiet reset, join us for: ✨

Clear the clutter. Focus on what matters.
Pause. Reflect. Grow. This is The Soul Edit.

Join hosts Nima Moghimian, PhD (Chief Technology Officer) and Steve Bell (Senior Business Development Manager) as they explore both proven and emerging graphene applications with some of industry’s most influential leaders.  Whether you’re an investor tracking the commercialization of advanced materials, a manufacturer seeking a competitive edge, an engineer optimizing production, or an R&D lead exploring new materials, this show delivers actionable insights to help you turn graphene into value across complex industrial applications. Every morning, For Fox Sake finds the one game with the best market story: where the line moved and why, where the public money is piling up, where the sharp money is hiding, and what it means for your bet. author: Jasmine Halpern
description:
Welcome to All That Jaz: let’s debrief life.
Hosted by Jasmine Halpern, All That Jaz is a reminder that none of us really know what the f**k we’re doing. From friendships and dating to pop culture, bad decisions, good stories, and the random things that somehow require a full-on podcast.
It’s the conversations that start at the pre-game, continue in the Uber, and end up in the group chat. Because we have to beat that horse until it’s truly dead.
Some convos get deep; some absolutely did not need this much analysis, but here we are.
Pull up a chair. We have a lot to discuss.
XOXO, Jaz 💋

Each story is read aloud by a warm British storyteller, about seven minutes long: just right for bedtime or story time. Written by A.J. McCarthy. The picture books are on Kindle, and you can find free activity sheets and the illustrated read-alongs at talesfromsaltby.com.

author: JD
description: Welcome to the Deep Dive. Life in modern times doesn't come with a manual, but it shouldn't feel like a constant grind. This show offers different perspective designed to help you smoothly navigate the complexities and difficulties of everyday life.  Through mindful reflections, practical mental models, and honest conversations, we break down popular mindsets to help you build true clarity and move forward with intention.  Subscribe for a Deep Dive to look at what it takes to live well today.

description: Calm, slow history to fall asleep to. Topics are chosen by hand and key facts are checked against real sources. The narration is synthesized (AI voice). New episodes every week. Good night. 🌙

In the besieged city of Musang, the gates are bricked shut, the rule is absolute—no one leaves, no one yields. Survival is measured in half-loaves of barley bread and roof beams torn from ancestral homes to brace a failing stone wall. When Lahegroo Nortong crawls out of the enemy’s thorn pens and scales the battlements under cover of darkness, he buys his place inside with a dead steward’s token and a desperate lie. Thrown onto the crumbling, timber-propped ramparts alongside Naedandra Spiker, an outland mercenary harboring a treasonous secret, and under the watchful eye of Mentist Tchwilday, the provisioner forced to weigh honor against the brutal arithmetic of starvation, Lahegroo must help hold the line against a relentless host of ogre sappers and wild-human bands. The Leaning Wall is a gritty, claustrophobic grimdark audio drama of wood, stone, and human endurance, where the class warfare behind the barricades is just as deadly as the army digging beneath them.
The Leaning Wall is a daily serial grimdark fantasy audiobook, with each episode a ground-level chronicle of survival.

author: Deer Camp Digital
description: Welcome to Deer Camp, where the stories are good and there’s always room for one more. Brought to you by a full service digital marketing agency for outdoor brands, we sit down for conversations about hunting, ranch life, and the people who make the outdoors worth sharing.

title: The Human Intelligence Advantage
author: Fiona Wilhelm
description: Almost 9 in 10 organisations use AI, but only 6% are seeing real financial results. AI strategist Fiona Wilhelm (ex-KPMG, PwC) talks with leaders and practitioners about what it really takes to go from experimenting with AI to changing how work gets done, and how to bring your people with you.

title: City Lights Film Podcast
author: City Lights Film Festival
description:
Welcome to the City Lights Film Podcast!
We are a BIFA-qualifying short film festival based in London, dedicated to championing the next generation of independent filmmakers. Every episode, we sit down with brilliant directors, writers, and creators from around the world to unpack their creative journeys, share backstage secrets, and find out exactly how they bring their stories to life. City Lights is also a proud member of AIFF (Association of Independent Film Festivals) and FFA (Film Festival Alliance).
Hosted by Angela Peters and Steve Harcourt

title: The David Show
author: David
description: A Chinese guy talking about the same experience and feelings you may have

title: For The Flock
author: Coffee Shop Ducks
description:
Welcome to For The Flock — the Coffee Shop Ducks podcast. ☕🦆
A slightly slower corner of Duckland where we can talk without trying to squeeze everything into a 10-second Reel.
Expect stories from behind Coffee Shop Ducks, what's happening in Duckland, the occasional ramble from Ducksy, your questions and conversations with members of the Flock.
No algorithms to chase. No three-second hooks. Just grab a coffee and come have a chat.
People over algorithms, always. 💜

title: The Long Game with Rishabh Jaiswal
author: Sporting Ethos
description:
Success in sport, and in life, isn't built in a day. It's built over years of patience, smart choices, setbacks and comebacks.
The Long Game is a podcast hosted by Rishabh Jaiswal, Managing Director of Sporting Ethos and Athlete First Foundation. Each episode explores what it really takes to go the distance: building lasting careers, staying healthy, and making decisions that pay off years from now, not just today.
Expect honest conversations on athlete health and injury, performance and recovery, the business and culture of sport, and the mindset behind long, meaningful careers.

title: the divorcing without damage podcast
author: Dr. Leslie Roberts
description: Divorcing Without Damage helps parents navigate separation and divorce with their children at the center. Hosted by Dr. Leslie Roberts, forensic psychologist and child-centered divorce coach, the show provides practical strategies, expert guidance, and honest conversations to help families reduce conflict, strengthen co-parenting, and protect kids from unnecessary emotional harm. Because divorce may end a marriage, but it doesn’t have to damage a childhood.

title: PA Founders
author: PA-Founders.com
description:
PA Founders interviews business owner and operators in central PA to help connect you with the interesting entrepreneurs living next door to you.
We aim to build a community of growth-minded individuals who want to connect with other Founders in the central PA area.

title: What The Kristy
author: What The Kristy
description: Former Twitch streamer Kristy traded marathon live broadcasts for naptime audio logs. What the Kristy is a bite-sized variety podcast about respawning in real life. Tune in for a chaotic but cozy mix of MMO updates, honest talk about faith and stay-at-home mom life, and "Random Encounters" casual guest episodes featuring other creators and gamers. Whether you are dealing with real-world aggro, keeping up with the latest raids, or just trying to find the meta in your own offline life, jump into the chat.

title: Professor Peterson and Professor AI
author: Professor Curtis Peterson
description: Professor Peterson and Professor AI is a podcast that brings together human experience and artificial intelligence to explore the complexities of the human condition. Hosted by Dr. Curtis Peterson, a social psychologist, and Professor AI, an artificial intelligence conversational partner, the podcast offers thoughtful discussions about psychology, identity, belonging, human relationships, and the evolving role of AI in our lives. Rather than approaching their conversations as teacher and student, both professors engage as intellectual partners, challenging assumptions, exchanging perspectives, and exploring new ideas. Grounded in curiosity, research, and the Ecological Identity Model (EIM), the podcast invites listeners to discover what happens when human insight and artificial intelligence come together in a shared pursuit of understanding.

title: STOPS.physio podcast
author: The team at STOPS.physio
description:
Conversations about improving low back pain care through evidence, clinical reasoning and individualised physiotherapy.
The STOPS.physio podcast brings together practitioners and researchers to explore assessment, barriers to recovery, treatment and the practical challenges of putting evidence into practice.
For practising physiotherapists, educators and researchers.
STOPS.physio — Better outcomes for low back pain

title: Community College And Beyond
author: Jose Del Real Viramontes
description: **Community College and Beyond: Testimonios, Knowledge, Transformation** is a podcast dedicated to amplifying the voices, experiences, and knowledge of community college students, alumni, educators, scholars, and advocates. Through powerful testimonios and meaningful conversations, we challenge deficit narratives about community colleges and the students they serve while highlighting the transformative power of community college education. From personal growth and career exploration to educational opportunities, community empowerment, and social mobility, we explore the many ways community col

title: Relationship Codes
author: Skuki Peeshaun
description: Relationship Codes with Skuki Peeshaun is a relationship podcast that explores love, dating, marriage, intimacy, communication and the realities of modern relationships. Through honest conversations, practical insights and relatable experiences, Skuki Peeshaun unpacks the codes to building healthier relationships, understanding partners and navigating the complexities of love.

title: Peptides Fresno
author: Michael Turner
description: Peptides Fresno is an educational podcast exploring peptide science, molecular biology, and the fascinating processes that connect different parts of the human immune system. Episodes examine scientific discoveries, cellular mechanisms, and emerging research to make complex biomedical topics easier to understand. The content is intended for educational purposes only and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment recommendations. Scientific discussions should not be interpreted as recommendations for personal medication use.

title: The Norm Report: Venturing into the Big Shift
author: Norm E. Murray
description:
AI is not just changing what leaders do. It is changing who they are.
The Norm Report is a podcast for CEOs, board members, and senior executives navigating the psychology and economics of the AI era. Each episode takes a clear position, backs it with data, and applies named frameworks to the questions leadership teams avoid: identity, judgment, relevance, trust, and the human cost of scaling AI.
Hosted by Norm E. Murray. Go deeper at normemurray.com.

title: Pickle Mars Podcast
author: Pickle Mars
description: Pickle Mars is a podcast about Philippine pickleball, hosted by Bryan Peralta, Sarah Jane Lim-Narvasa, and Leander Lazaro. We talk about the people, stories, hot takes, challenges, and opportunities shaping the sport in the Philippines, from grassroots development and competition to the growing professional scene.

title: Wrong but Listen
author: Wrong but Listen
description: Wrong but listen covers sports, movies and current events.

title: More Than Rocks
author: Louise Daines-Vick
description: An IAEG podcast. More Than Rocks is a journey into the fascinating world of engineering geology. Through candid interviews with leading practitioners and scientists, we uncover what it truly means to be an engineering geologist.We dive into the unique career paths of eng geos from around the globe, exploring their education, experiences, successes, and the lessons learnt. These intimate, meandering conversations offer a rare glimpse into the lives of those shaping the field, blending personal stories professional insights.

title: Creeptopia All Ages Creep-Cast
author: Steven Honeycutt
description:
Welcome to Creeptopia, where creepy meets crazy, and monsters are always lurking around the corner!
Join host Blayde and his dad, Steve, for all-ages fun as they explore some of the internet's creepiest creatures, murkiest monsters, and most mysterious legends!
From terrifying internet sensations like Cartoon Cat and Siren Head to bizarre creatures from the world of video games, Blayde and Steve dive into the stories, secrets, and strange origins behind your favorite monsters. Expect plenty of laughs, spooky surprises, and a few chills along the way!
But that's not all! Every episode featur

title: PWTV Archive Podcast

Every episode we'll look at new uploads from various wrestling promotions on YouTube - spotlighting great shows, talking about matches on said shows and diving into whatever pro wrestling news is happening.

title: Letters Lane EN

Every day, letters find their way to Sophia's desk.
Among them, she chooses one letter to open and share.
Each letter carries a story, a memory, or a feeling that has lingered quietly in someone's heart.
From that letter, a song is born.

author: NickV Ministries
description:
I am Nick Vujucic, born without arms or legs. Welcome to these life-changing resources. NickV Ministries is all about sharing the same hope and genuine love that I have personally experienced with people all over the globe. Doors seem open to a man without arms and legs much more easily than to anyone else. We thank God for providing that privilege. I have been invited into very unexpected places to share my faith in Jesus Christ and literally millions have responded.

We hope you will watch, engage with, and share the videos on our channel! To learn more about the ministry visit http://www.nickvministries.org.

title: Walk With Me: A Real Walking Podcast for Women Over 40
author: Nat Lockhart | Slightly Seasoned
description:
Most walking podcasts are about walking. Walk With Me is a walk. It's a free walking podcast for midlife women over 40, recorded in real time on a real trail. Unedited, unfiltered, and about 20 to 30 minutes long. Rain, bugs, wind, and other people's dogs are all included.
I'm Nat Lockhart, a certified nutrition coach, and I walk with you, in your ears, for women who'd rather not walk alone. I'll check your form, nudge you to pick it up, and notice when you're coasting. Each walk takes on one everyday behaviour, like hydration, sleep, stress, or listening to your body, with a little coaching and a little motivation.
Pop me in your ears and go for a walk. Pick the topic that hurts most and start there. It's free, and it's built for a real week, not a perfect one.

title: Darwin College Lecture Series
author: Darwin College Lecture Series
description:
Darwin College at Cambridge University has delivered eight public lectures each year since 1986, each series built around a single theme and approached from multiple disciplines. Leading scholars prepare their talks for general audiences, not specialists. Recent themes include Song, Code, and Revolution. Each series is later published as a book by Cambridge University Press. The range runs from asteroseismology to Palestinian music, from epigenetics to the cultural revolution in China. Follow the show and leave a five-star rating if you find an idea worth keeping.

Links:
Darwin College Lecture Series: https://www.darwin.cam.ac.uk/lectures
Darwin College: https://www.darwin.cam.ac.uk/

title: Coffee and Convo
author: Facing Freedom Ministries
description: Grab your coffee and come sit with me! Welcome to Coffee & Convo, a podcast from Facing Freedom Ministries where we talk about real life, real struggles, and everyday questions through biblical truth. No perfect people, no complicated theology, just honest conversations about faith, freedom, and learning to walk with Jesus in everyday life. Come as you are, bring your questions, and let’s grow together, one conversation at a time.

title: Hoops Central: NBA news and analysis
author: Hoops Central
description:
Welcome to Hoops Central—your daily front-row seat to everything happening across the NBA.

We cut through the noise to bring you real talk on the biggest storylines across the Association: breaking trade intel, injury updates, locker room drama, and instant post-game reactions. From prime-time buzzer beaters to the storylines shaping the playoff race, if it happens on or off the hardwood, we’re breaking it down.

title: Liquidation Lowdown: Making Margin Impact at Every Stage of the CPG Supply Chain
author: Spoiler Alert
description:
The CPG supply chain podcast for leaders who deliver organizational excellence at every stage of the product's lifecycle, from launch to liquidation.
We host CPG experts to discuss the latest industry news, trends, and insights to keep you informed, inspired, and one step ahead.

title: Midnight Feeds
author: Tess | Midnight Feeds
description:
Welcome to Midnight Feeds — a little company for the middle of the night.
Hosted by Tess, a mum of three, this cosy, honest and sometimes hilarious podcast explores the side of motherhood we don't always talk about.
From sleepless nights and mum guilt to overwhelming love, everyday chaos and small wins, we're talking about it all.
Whether you're feeding your baby at 2am or hiding in the pantry eating chocolate, you're welcome here.
No judgement. No pressure to have it all together. Just real conversations, a little laughter and 15 minutes of company.
Because mums need looking after too.

title: History Leads
author: Sophie Trent
description:
Each episode of History Leads tells the story of one historical figure, one defining moment, and the timeless lesson it holds for leaders today. From George Washington walking away from power to the choices that changed nations, these are short, story-driven episodes for anyone who leads a business, a team, a community, or a family.
Hosted by Sophie Trent, History Leads brings the past to life in under ten minutes, because history has a lot to teach us about leading well.
New episodes every week.

title: Revenue Management Conversations
author: City Shift Finance
description: Revenue Management Conversations is the revenue management podcast from City Shift Finance. Episodes cover pricing strategy, demand forecasting, dynamic pricing, segmentation, discounting, capacity, channel strategy, commercial performance, and margin across industries. The show combines concise episodes with conversations featuring executives and practitioners working in revenue management, pricing, finance, and commercial strategy. Our third podcast, City Shift Finance Hotel Finance Explained, presents adaptations of our published hotel research.

title: The Alpha Female
author: ProfDaddyJOY and Dasol Kim
description: Relationship Intelligence for Women Who Have Everything Except the Partnership They Want. Hosted by the man in the partnership, with the an Alpha Female as co-host and living proof.

title: Global Law Experts: One Network Talking
author: Global Law Experts
description: Conversations with leading lawyers from the Global Law Experts network, the specialists clients turn to across practice areas and jurisdictions worldwide. Every episode is a different format: Q&As that answer the questions clients actually ask, In-Depth deep dives on a single topic, Discussions between two peers, Roundtables of six to eight members from one practice group or region, and LinkedIn Live sessions. Practical, cross-border legal insight, straight from the experts.

title: Ray Reads
author: Ray Roberts
description: You should really read. It'll make you smarter and more interesting to people. I know you won't read though, it's too much work. SO I'll do it for you. We're going to read books that you've heard of but either won't ever read, or haven't read in years just so you can sound smart when they come up in conversation.

title: The Car Show: History & Heroes
author: PNW MOVES
description:
Hosted by Leo Schumaker and Brian Corey, The Car Show: History & Heroes covers the people, stories and vehicles that have shaped the way we move. Recorded live on 88.3 KMRE in Bellingham, WA and broadcast around the globe, each week we dive into a new topic and invite people to call in and share their tales. 
Leo Schumaker is a Navy veteran and lifelong car collector. Brian Corey is a media producer and president of PNWMOVES.org, a 501c3 nonprofit dedicated to building a transportation museum and car culture center in Bellingham, WA.

title: The Conscious Good Vibes Podcast
author: Conscious Good Vibes
description:
The Conscious Good Vibes Podcast is a space for honest, down-to-earth conversations about health, happiness and finding more balance in everyday life.
We explore practical ways to support your wellbeing and become more connected to yourself and the world around you. From food, movement, breath and rest to mindset, journaling and personal growth, we share ideas and perspectives to help you live well and feel good.
No perfection. No one-size-fits-all answers. Just conscious choices, meaningful conversations and good vibes.
www.consciousgoodvibes.com
www.becomingyoujournal.com

title: Straight Talk with Phil
author: Phil
description:
Straight Talk with Phil is a practical mental wellbeing podcast focused on stress, anxiety, depression, trauma and emotional regulation.
Hosted by Strategic Psychotherapist and Clinical Hypnotherapist Phil Meredith, each episode offers grounded insights and gentle and proven tools to help you feel calmer, clearer, and more in control.
This isn’t therapy or quick fixes, it’s practical guidance you can use in everyday life, at your own pace.
Free worksheets and resources are available in the episode notes.

title: Pass/Fail
author: Pass/Fail
description: Pass/Fail is a podcast from NI | Emerson and Averna Powered by Spherea exploring what it really takes to bring complex products to life and prove they will perform in the real world. Through candid conversations with engineers and industry experts, we uncover the challenges, decisions, failures, and lessons learned that shape the journey from prototype to production, ultimately turning innovative ideas into products people can rely on every day.

title: DIARY OF A MARKET MANIAC
author: Diary of a market maniac
description: Welcome to the only casino with no house. Every week, Marcus and Jay open up the prediction markets, where regular people trade on baseball games, elections, Bitcoin, and the Nobel Peace Prize, sometimes all before lunch. They ask what the crowd believes, then ask the only question that matters: is the crowd drunk? Serious about the money, funny about everything else. Not financial advice. Just a diary.

title: The Diary of an American Dream
author: FanAttic
description:
On the 17th of March, 1887, a young Swedish man made a decision that would change the course of his life.
His name was Peter Karlsson. He was nineteen years old.
He was leaving home, leaving his family, and setting out for America.
He would record his journey in a diary. More than a hundred years later, those pages would give us a remarkable account of an ordinary young man facing an extraordinary adventure.

title: LukeBuild
author: Luke
description:
Welcome to LukeBuild — a build-in-public devlog by Luke, an indie hacker creating micro-SaaS, hardware experiments, and aesthetic web tools from scratch.
Each week, I share short audio logs on the tech stack, product decisions, design trade-offs, and what it really takes to ship solo.

title: Tales Checked
author: Tales Checked
description: Every legend, checked against the record. Tales Checked investigates the stories everyone thinks they know — Lilith, the Plague Doctor, the Anunnaki — and tests them against the earliest surviving sources. New episode every Saturday. The audio edition of the Tales Checked video series.

title: Classical Voices with Cynthia Phillippi
author: cynthia.phillippi
description:
Come sit down with Cynthia and her guests to talk all things classical music and beyond! 
Episodes every other Wednesday

title: Voices of Impact
author: helloh4b
description:
Voices of Impact: The stories behind Impact Hub Ottawa's community of changemakers.

The Impact Hub is the coworking space for making social impact in Ottawa. It delivers coworking and meeting space, skills development training, and networking events. It’s part of a global network of like-minded spaces teeming with fascinating people with exciting new ideas about how make a difference, here in Ottawa and around the world. On the Hubcast Weekly, we’ll bring you their stories.

Voices of Impact is produced by Studio Canek.

title: Rooted with Chaos
author: RootedWithChaos
description:
Welcome your new favorite PODCAST addiction... "Rooted with Chaos"-a sisters podcast. Embark on a journey through the challenges and triumphs we face in the Chaotic lives of sisterhood! We hope you enjoy our stories of family, travel, life, and everything in between! 
Episodes will drop once a week right here on Spotify!

rootedwithchaos@gmail.com
Welcome to the fam!

title: Wolf Business Review Podcast
author: Wolf Business Review
description: Wolf Business Review Podcast explores business, education, and technology through research, ideas, innovation, and interdisciplinary conversation. Episodes examine artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, leadership, teaching and learning, organizational decision-making, and emerging technology. The podcast may include synthetic AI hosts and AI-assisted content presented transparently under human editorial oversight.

title: Ad Bits with Alex Grossman
author: Alex Grossman
description:
Ad Bits with Alex Grossman is a podcast about ads, production and creativity. Honest conversations with the people shaping the work.
We get into decision making, leadership, craft, freelancing, navigating change and what it really takes to make things happen in this industry.
No hype. No fluff. Just honest conversations with people who've been there.
Supported by Green Desert. UK representation for trusted service production across Europe.
New episodes weekly.

title: The Second Table Podcast
author: The Second Table Podcast
description:
The Second Table brings you a new perspective on wealth and legacy.
Every Thursday, Vicky Tan and Benn Lee talk through one or two financial stories from Malaysia and the world: what happened, why it matters, how it affects you and your family. Family offices, succession, markets, AI and more, in plain language.
A Timeless Podcast, sponsored by Timeless International Family Office.

title: The ASA Files: Tales from the Abyss
author: The Narrator
description: The ASA Files, a dark fantasy audio horror told through declassified records: debriefs and testimony from the people sent down into a living abyss. When the Abyss Anomaly tore open the earth, five nations formed the Abyssal Studies Authority (ASA) to govern what lay below. On the rim grew a city no one planned, the Allied Demilitarized Exploration Zone. Back home, ASA posters sell the Abyss as an opportunity. The brave souls who dare the descent are called divers, and not all of them come back the same. These files represent the ASA's attempt to explain something that can't be explained.

title: Zac’s Take
author: Zac
description:
Zac's Take​ is a podcast about the ideas behind the headlines.
Each episode starts with a book, an essay, or an argument — then digs into what it tells us about Western politics, culture, and the social debates we're stuck in: democracy, free speech, identity, media, and more.
No hot takes. No cable-news noise. Just one person reading widely, thinking out loud, and helping you make sense of the moment.
New episodes drop alongside the YouTube channel, made for listening on walks and commutes.

title: 3 guys Zero Proof

title: Simons Foundation Lectures
author: Simons Foundation
description:
The Simons Foundation’s mission is to advance the frontiers of research in mathematics and the basic sciences.

Co-founded in New York City by Jim and Marilyn Simons, the foundation exists to support basic — or discovery-driven — scientific research undertaken in the pursuit of understanding the phenomena of our world.

The Simons Foundation’s support of science takes two forms: We support research by making grants to individual investigators and their projects through academic institutions, and, with the launch of the Flatiron Institute in 2016, we now conduct scientific research in-house, supporting teams of top computational scientists.

romanticizing life, nurturing my deen 🌙

title: QuantumBloom Conversations
author: QuantumBloom
description: Early-career STEM attrition is expensive, predictable and preventable. QuantumBloom Conversations is for the HR, talent and business leaders responsible for the engineers, scientists and technologists their organizations can’t afford to lose. As AI redefines what “ready” means, we talk with industry leaders, researchers and rising STEM talent about what keeps technical talent, what builds it, and the durable human skills (judgment, influence, communication) that turn early-career potential into tomorrow’s leadership pipeline. From QuantumBloom, STEM workforce infrastructure for employers.

title: Messy Ministries
author: Messy Ministries
description: Messy Ministries is an advice ministry and the home of your revered mojihost, Nandi. The voice behind Messy Ministries’ virtual mojihost belongs to someone with decades of experience in relating and knocking her own head up against brick walls. She brings her knowledge of having lived, loved and lost (thanks, grandma!) to help others resolve issues in their life—even if the issue is them. Our mission is to provide unfiltered, no-holds-barred advice on relationships, dating, parenting, health, messy neighbors—whatever the case may be. Thank you for listening!

title: Future of Work
author: Rikii Jordan
description: Future of Work: Careers, Technology & New Opportunities, a podcast exploring the changing world of careers, employment, and professional development. Discover how technology, artificial intelligence, digital transformation, and new workplace trends are reshaping industries and creating exciting career opportunities. From emerging professions and essential job skills to remote work, entrepreneurship, leadership, and professional growth, each episode brings valuable insights to help you understand the future of employment. Join us as we explore new possibilities, workplace innovation, and the skills needed to succeed in tomorrow's world.

title: Holding Both with June Callahan
author: June Callahan
description: You can hold their hand and hold on to your life. A daily show for adults caring for an aging parent: one lesson from the caregiving trenches, one small act for your own life, and a Question of the Day answered by people who understand your two in the morning. From the book Caring for Aging Parents by June Callahan — get it wherever books are sold.

title: Behind The Closed Mic
author: BehindTheClosedMic
description: Behind The Closed Mic is where the conversations we keep to ourselves finally find a voice. 🎙️ An anonymous space for raw, unfiltered conversations about motherhood, relationships, family, personal struggles, and the truths we’re often afraid to say out loud. No judgment. No pretending. Just real stories, honest conversations, uncomfortable truths, and reminders that none of us are truly alone. Because sometimes, the conversations behind closed doors are the ones that need to be heard most. The mic is open. Your identity stays yours.

title: Piece by Piece
author: Philadelphia Museum of Art
description:
Piece by Piece is a podcast created by Philadelphia teens at the Philadelphia Museum of Art.
Season 1, A Cacophony of Artists, puts them behind the mic as researchers, writers, hosts, and producers, exploring art through their own questions, conversations, and perspectives.
Created in collaboration with Big Picture Alliance and Rowhome Productions and inspired by A Nation of Artists, this season features conversations with artists, curators, and other voices as our teen hosts uncover the stories behind the art, piece by piece.

author: Dr. Carolyn
description: For years, The Dr. Carolyn Show has created space for conversations that matter. Now, the conversation continues—in a new way. Here, we'll talk about the mind, body, health, life, relationships, purpose, human performance, thought provoking discussions and everyday life—and the experiences that shape who we become.  Some conversations will make you think.  Some will make you laugh.  Some may challenge what you believe.  And some may change the way you see yourself.

title: What If I Don't Die
author: Scott Gray
description:
The podcast for financial advisors who are ready to close the biggest gap in most protection plans — disability, not just death.
dibrokerWest's disability insurance specialists break down the real conversations, the real numbers and the real objections advisors run into when selling DI — so you walk into your next client meeting with a better question, not just a better pitch.

title: Live Reconnected
author: Will Schiller
description:
The Reconnected Health Podcast is about building a strong body and a life you’re fully present for.
We explore strength, nutrition, longevity, bloodwork, sleep and human performance—but also family, purpose, nature, community, adventure and what it means to live well.
Because health isn’t the destination. It’s what allows you to fully participate in your life.
Reconnect to yourself. Reconnect to your family. Reconnect to life.
Live Reconnected.

title: Unscripted Bears
author: ProductivityBears
description: We feature early-stage entrepreneurs sharing the real, unscripted journeys of building businesses from nothing. Hear about the wins, the losses, and the lessons learned from first-time founders. Join the community and get the blueprint through the stories of those doing the work.

title: How to Build A Life?
author: Nate Surget
description: How do you build a life? Whether or not you have a good answer to that question, you may want to hear how others have built theirs. title: It’s Not The Book
author: itsnotthebookpod
description:
WE'RE BACK… AND WE'VE GOT OPINIONS!

Welcome to the relaunch of It's Not the Book — the only podcast where the body count is high, our standards are even higher, & absolutely nobody is safe from our opinions.

Each week, we dive headfirst into horror, thrillers, fantasy, contemporary fiction, romance, & dark romance. "Why choose" one genre when you can have murder, magic, mayhem, questionable love interests, & a little spice all in one place?

Expect sharp commentary on plot holes, side-eye for characters who hear strange noises in the basement & STILL decide to investigate, & heated debates about which one of us would survive the first act. (Spoiler: We're GenX. We were raised on horror movies. We know better than to go upstairs.)

We're here to question everything, celebrate the twists, roast the ridiculous, defend our fictional favorites, & say what everyone else is probably thinking. No literary snobbery. No sugarcoating. No participation trophies for poorly written characters. Definitely no guarantee we'll agree!

We're bringing the GenX attitude, the unfiltered commentary, the occasional tangent, & absolutely no F*CKS given about pretending to like a book just because everyone else does.

If you love your books dark, your plot twists messy, your romance spicy, your characters questionable, & your conversations completely unfiltered… LOCK YOUR DOORS, GRAB YOUR BOOKS, AND JOIN US. We survived the '80s & '90s....we can certainly survive a fictional haunted house.

description:

I’m here to help you connect biblical truth to everyday family life so you can approach Christian parenting with confidence, teach your children what matters most, and prepare them for real life.
I’m Hannah, a homeschool mom, registered nurse, health coach, and military wife. I grew up in a faith-filled home, and as I’ve navigated motherhood in a world full of competing voices and overwhelming information, I’ve learned the importance of using biblical truth and discernment to guide the decisions I make and the information I use to teach and raise my kids.
Here on Raising Kingdom Kids, we’ll explore biblical motherhood, family culture, faith, identity, character, healthy habits, practical life skills, and the hard conversations our children need us to have with them...all filtered through the lens of God’s Word. My heart is to help you cultivate an intentional, faith-filled home and equip your children with the understanding, convictions, and life skills they need to think wisely, navigate real life, and stand firm in their faith.
We can’t protect our kids from everything they’ll encounter. But we can prepare them.

title: VALOR
author: Val Beck | Lorena Garcia
description:
A socialist and a suburban mom with very different views on progressive politics. Spoiler: they agree.
Hosted by Colorado State Rep. Lorena Garcia and Democratic strategist Val Beck
We’re Val Beck and Lorena Garcia, two Colorado women in our 40s who’ve both put our names on the ballot.
Lorena ran for the U.S. Senate and serves as a State Representative. She’s a walking cliche - a socialist and a lesbian Latina lawmaker who runs a nonprofit. Val is a soon to be TV show lead character - a former Wheat Ridge city councilor, a 20-year Democratic strategist, a straight suburban moderate, and a colorectal cancer survivor. On paper, we shouldn’t get along. 
But we went to high school together, found each other again in Colorado politics, and figured out something nobody tells you: We can agree on way more than we could fight about. Clean water. Housing our kids can afford. Health care that doesn’t bankrupt you. Public lands that stay public. Neighbors who show up for each other. And standing with our immigrant neighbors.
We’re also caregivers. We know what it’s like to juggle a sick family member, a job, or jobs, and a campaign at the same time. Like most women, we don’t have time for purity tests. We’ve got people and communities to take care of.
So we argue it out like friends over drinks, grocery shopping, driving from one errand to the next, find the common ground, and get to work. VALOR is two women from different corners of the Democratic tent proving that when we stop talking past each other, we get things done.

description: Late At The Well is a podcast for those who have discovered faith later in life.  If you've ever felt overwhelmed by church culture, confused by the vocabulary, or wondered how to navigate your new beliefs when you're already settled into who you are, you are not alone.  Join host Dani McArthur as she shares the beauty, the culture shock, and the honest realities of becoming a Christian as an adult.

author: Olga Figueroa
description:

Through honest conversations and personal experiences, Olga goes beyond the polished "after" to uncover the decisions, setbacks, lessons, and courageous actions that happened in between.
You'll hear from entrepreneurs, professionals, veterans, creators, and everyday people who have rebuilt, reinvented, or created something meaningful—and are willing to tell the truth about what it took to get there.

As an ancient world approaches a profound transformation, Kalen discovers that time, consciousness, and creation hold secrets beyond imagination.

Life can be chaotic.  Finding peace in the middle of it doesn't mean turning down the volume on life.

Sometimes thoughtful, sometimes funny, and always authentic, each episode is an opportunity to connect, reflect, and maybe see life from a different angle. 


Whether flying solo or sitting down with a guest, JCHILL brings curiosity, humor, and a lifetime of experiences to the microphone.  Known as The Monk with the Distortion Pedal, JCHILL believes that finding peace doesn't mean selling out or settling. 


Because I believe my best days, and yours, are still in front of us.  


Until next time, stay chill.

description:
The stories behind the hits. The people who made them. The next generation waiting to be discovered.

What does it really take to make it in the music industry? Who decides which artists get discovered, which records become hits, and which careers change music forever?

Welcome to Hustle Sold Separately, the music industry podcast and live A&R experience hosted by veteran music executive Adrian L. Miller and executive produced by legendary hip-hop broadcasters Sway & King Tech.

With decades of experience discovering, managing, and developing talent, including Anderson .Paak, The Pharcyde, and October London, Adrian brings listeners inside the rooms where music history was made.

Each episode features candid conversations with influential artists, Grammy-winning producers, songwriters, A&R executives, and music industry insiders who reveal the untold stories behind iconic records, breakthrough artists, and career-defining moments.

But this isn't just another music interview podcast.

Hustle Sold Separately puts the next generation of talent in the room.

Through live demo reviews, independent artists get their music heard and receive honest feedback, artist development advice, and real-world insight from the people who have helped shape the industry.

From hip-hop and R&B to music production, songwriting, artist management, record labels, and the business of music, every episode connects the lessons of the past with the artists building the future.

Whether you're an independent artist looking for your breakthrough, an aspiring producer learning the business, or a music fan who wants to know how legendary records came to life, this is your backstage pass to the music industry.

Part music discovery. Part masterclass. Part living music history.

Game recognize game. Hustle sold separately by Adrian L Miller.

title: The Fermi Paradox

description:
The universe should be teeming with life, so where is everybody? This mystery is known as the Fermi Paradox. Corey S. Powell and George Musser, two award-winning science journalists, search for answers. We interview top astronomers, philosophers, and science-fiction creators. We run down every possibility, from alien artifacts on the moon to signals from deep space. And we prepare for the possibility: If we make contact, how will we talk to an alien civilization?
Every step of the way, Powell and Musser bring a skeptical eye to the subject, while celebrating the vast unknowns of the universe.

description:
Too many Christian men are carrying the weight of divorce, shame, failure, and spiritual emptiness in silence — and no one around them knows it. They look fine. They keep showing up. They keep performing. But inside, something is dying.


The Mike Mack Show is a Christian men’s podcast for the man who is tired of pretending he is okay. Hosted by Michael Mack — Christian, father, businessman, former attorney, and survivor of his own season of financial, emotional, and spiritual collapse — this show goes to the places most men’s content refuses to go. Faith, fitness, fatherhood, emotional honesty, post-divorce identity, brotherhood, and what it actually looks like for a broken man to become a restored one.


This is not a show about motivation. It is a show about transformation. The kind that requires surrender, truth, discipline, and the willingness to let the old man die so the restored man can rise.

Welcome to The David’s Diary Podcast with Bunmi, a warm, honest space for neurodivergent life, seen through the eyes of faith.


I’m Bunmi, author of the David’s Diary children’s book series, and I’m also a neurodivergent mom who has also walked this road with my own kids. Whether you’re autistic, have ADHD, or are parenting a child who does, you’re not alone here. We talk about the real stuff: school, friends (or a lack thereof), IEP meetings and therapy appointments, feeling misunderstood, and how awesome it is to have Jesus to help us overcome & to be our Friend. 


Every episode comes from a place of faith, with the belief that God is always for you. Expect encouragement, practical advice, a little humor, and plenty of heart.

Real People. Raw Conversations. No Fluff. Just Depth.

What does it really take to build something extraordinary?
And what happens behind the success stories nobody talks about?

Welcome to Unfiltered Minds, hosted by entrepreneur Stasia Sliusari.

From building multimillion-dollar businesses and navigating failure to money, relationships, personal growth, technology, and the pursuit of freedom, nothing is off the table.

The Capability Podcast is a series of honest conversations about pressure, resilience, responsibility, failure, fatherhood, leadership and rebuilding when life doesn’t go to plan.

title: Tana Tells Tales
author: Tana
description:
Classic literature, one chapter at a time.
Welcome to Tana Tells Tales, where I read classics, strange stories, mythology, poetry, Gothic horror, forgotten gems, and books I've somehow never heard of.
Some stories I love. Some I've always meant to read. Some will have me asking, “I'm sorry, the WHAT?”

Come sit down. I found a story.

title: Money Under Deception
author: Ashraf
description:
Money Under Deception: Wall Street’s Biggest Scams — When Money Becomes a Weapon

Money promises security, opportunity, and freedom. But what happens when the people trusted to protect it turn it into a weapon? Money Under Deception is a two-part investigative true-finance podcast exploring some of the most notorious financial scandals in modern American history.

In this series, we uncover the stories behind extraordinary financial frauds, examining how powerful individuals and respected corporations manipulated trust, concealed losses, and persuaded investors to believe in illusions. From Bernie Madoff’s devastating Ponzi scheme to the spectacular collapse of Enron, each episode reveals the human cost of financial deception.

Beyond the headlines and billions of dollars in losses, these are stories about ordinary people who trusted the wrong promises, employees whose futures disappeared, and institutions that failed to recognize—or stop—the warning signs.

Through gripping storytelling, clear explanations, and historical context, the series explores how these schemes operated, why intelligent people were deceived, and what allowed misconduct to continue for so long.

Money Under Deception is more than a collection of financial crime stories. It is a warning about unchecked ambition, the danger of blind trust, and the importance of transparency and accountability. Because when money becomes a weapon, the damage reaches far beyond Wall Street.

title: No Risk No Story with Meenakshi
author: meenakshi Chatterjee
description: You're at a crossroads, wondering if you should play it safe or chase something that scares you. No Risk No Story with Meenakshi features real people who chose the uncertain path and made it work through hard work and creativity. You'll hear their stories, pick up practical advice, and find the inspiration to make your own bold choice.

title: Outnumbered
author: Sean Kelly
description: Outnumbered is the debate show where one person steps into the arena and defends their beliefs against a crowd that disagrees with everything they stand for. No scripts. No safe answers. Just raw, unfiltered debate where conviction gets tested in real time. Every episode, one guest sits across from people who fundamentally oppose their worldview — on religion, money, gender, politics, culture, and everything in between. The crowd pushes back. The tension builds. And the truth comes out. Can one person hold their ground while outnumbered?

title: Beyond Sundays With Kennedy Podcast
author: BeyondSundaysWithKennedy
description:
Between Sundays with Kennedy
Real People. Real Stories. Real Faith.
Faith isn’t just for Sundays. It’s meant to be lived out every single day.
Between Sundays with Kennedy is a Christ-centered podcast where real people share real stories of faith, struggles, victories, and the life-changing power of Jesus Christ.
Through honest conversations and powerful testimonies, we explore what it looks like to follow Jesus beyond the church walls and navigate the everyday challenges of life while keeping our faith at the center.
From overcoming addiction and walking through difficult seasons to strengthening marriages, raising families, and growing spiritually, no story is too messy and no topic is off the table.
Our heart is to encourage you, challenge you, and remind you that God is still moving in the lives of ordinary people in extraordinary ways.
Because faith isn’t just something we practice on Sundays. It’s how we live between them.

title: Death Row Cases
author: Death Row Cases
description:
Death Row Cases follows real American death row cases in depth, one case at a time. Built from public court records, appellate rulings, and published news coverage, no speculation, no shock value, just what actually happened and what happened next.

title: The Matriarchy Would Never | A Promote Yourself to CEO Podcast Series
author: Racheal Cook MBA: Small Business Owner, Entrepreneur, Business Growth Strategist
description:
A private podcast series hosted by Racheal Cook, founder of The CEO Collective®


Most business advice assumes someone else is handling your life. Someone picks up the sick kid, keeps track of the pediatrician, and holds everything together at home while you build. If that someone is you, the plan was always going to break.


That isn’t a discipline problem. It’s a design flaw.


In this six-episode private series, Racheal Cook takes apart the things women entrepreneurs have been told are just “how business works.” She names the assumption underneath each one, then rebuilds it into something that actually works for the life you have. 


Episodes 1 through 3 name it: the invisible safety net, girl boss culture sold back to women as “patriarchy in pink,” and the persuasion tactics built to shut down your critical thinking. 


Episodes 4 through 6 rebuild it: a planning exercise that puts you back in your own business plan, the values-driven decisions that shaped The CEO Collective (and what each one cost), and a conversation with financial planner Cris Caruso about building a referral business on hospitality and taking a full month off.


Made for service-based, relationship-driven women business owners who are done hustling harder for a playbook that was never built for them.


Racheal Cook, MBA, has spent nearly 20 years helping women entrepreneurs build businesses that hold when life doesn’t. She is the creator of the 90 Day CEO Operating System® and host of Promote Yourself to CEO®.

title: Well, This Has Been Lovely
author: Joey Camasta
description:
"Well… this has been lovely." Sometimes Joey Camasta means it sincerely. Sometimes, it means get your bag and get out of my house.

You might know him as one half of It's Happening with Snooki & Joey. This one is all his. Makeup artist, beauty guru and hot mess homemaker, Joey has spent over a decade behind a microphone, and now he finally has a room of his own.

Each week he gets into whatever is driving him insane, whatever everybody is talking about, and whatever crisis he's currently dealing with. And because he loves having company over, there will be guests: celebrities, comedians, internet legends, and honestly, possibly his cleaning lady, if the story is good enough. Less interview, more kiki. Expect all his tips and tricks across food, beauty and entertaining too, plus your calls, your problems and your business.

Whether you need a recipe, a makeup tip or a mental breakdown, he's got you covered. His life might be falling apart, but yours won't be.
